first_line: The 5-minute evening review the Stoics actually ran.
Why you replay the argument at 2am, and the move that stops it.
When someone is rude to you today, Marcus Aurelius had already planned for it.
You don't have a discipline problem. You have a self-trust problem.
Tag the friend who does this. Then go to sleep. 😅
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
